text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you have a minute? Thing is,
I have a
test tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But today, I realized that I messed up,
and the
material I've been studying
won't be on the test.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So you know what I have to do now,
right?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Go right into the test with no
preparation!
Problem solved!
